verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or any way to register external tool servers. The documented extension points (/web scraping, /run, Python scripting, the community 'navigator-mode' package) are not MCP-client support and earn no credit.
